card.name: Linking words in spinal anesthesia warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, in, as, including, e.g.,) that follow a noun or verb in warnings about epidural, spinal or neuraxial anesthesia and its complications.

modes.label: Link before block outcome
modes.description: Words like of, in, including right before an effect of a spinal or epidural block, such as paralysis or regression of analgesia.
modes.example: Ephedrine may decrease the efficacy of epidural blockade by hastening the regression<< of>> sensory analgesia.
